_doc: Every action the UI's Operations / Settings pages can run, and exactly what it runs (deploy/agent.py executes it,
the platform validates parameters and shows the command). Nothing else can be run through the UI.
Tokens: "{p}" = the value of param p (token dropped when empty); "{p?TEXT}" = TEXT when p is true;
"{p*}" = one token per item of list p; "x{p}y" = p inside a token. A command starting with "argus.ps1" runs
through Windows PowerShell. approval: "production" = two named people and a reason while the API runs in
production mode. timeout_min: null = no limit (long jobs).

serve.label: Serve a run
serve.description: Starts the UI stack, the Fraud Model API and the vLLM explainer with this run (scoring only when the run has no AWQ explainer).

unserve.label: Stop serving
unserve.description: Stops the Fraud Model API and vLLM (frees the GPU for training). Live traffic falls back to the fail-open rule.

apply.label: Apply settings
apply.description: Recreates services so they pick up changed settings (.env). Serving and stream services only if they run now.

pipeline.label: Run the whole pipeline
pipeline.description: setup -> health check -> train the profile's runs -> reports -> serve -> API scenarios + load test -> aws.env (deploy/hyperstack/pipeline.sh).

setup.label: Set up / update the VM
setup.description: deploy/hyperstack/setup_vm.sh: Docker + NVIDIA toolkit (if missing), .env secrets, images, data and the profile's models. Safe to re-run.

check.label: Health check
check.description: deploy/hyperstack/check.sh: GPU, disk, Docker, .env, data, images, runs and services (full: also CUDA in the image, model access and the test suites).

demo.label: API scenarios (CRD 10 / LLD 6)
demo.description: Replays the CRD / LLD scenarios against the running Fraud Model API; results in training/outputs/<run>/api/demo_results.json.

loadtest.label: Load test (OBJ-10)
loadtest.description: End-to-end latency at a fixed request rate against the running Fraud Model API (it competes with live traffic).

stream_start.label: Start the local stream
stream_start.description: Kinesis emulator + stream scorer on this machine (the Live stream page). On AWS the stream runs on Fargate.

stream_stop.label: Stop the local stream
stream_stop.description: Stops the local Kinesis emulator and stream scorer.

sync_data.label: Sync the dataset
sync_data.description: Downloads dataset changes from Supabase (training files and the feature / label tables).
linux: from argus_ft.supabase_data import fetch_tables, sync; sync('data/raw'); fetch_tables('data/db')
windows: from argus_ft.supabase_data import fetch_tables, sync; sync('data/raw'); fetch_tables('data/db')

prefetch.label: Download a profile's models
prefetch.description: Checks gated access and downloads every model a profile uses, so GPU time is never spent downloading.

report.label: Compare runs (report)
report.description: Writes report.md per run and training/outputs/comparison.md for the selected runs.

build.label: Build images
build.description: Rebuilds images after a code update (training first: scoring and MLflow build on it). Apply afterwards to restart services.
